full_level_convention.definition: ratio = (Rd/g) * logmean(Tv_k, Tv_k+1) * ln(P_k+1/P_k) / geometric thickness between full levels k and k+1, k = 1..73, Tv = T*(1+(Rv/Rd-1)*QV) without condensate loading, ICON constants

flexpart_reconstruction_minus_hhl_full_l.definition: FLEXPART verttransform_mod.f90:1998-2023 replay (double precision, provider P in place of akz+bkz*ps, FLEXPART constants) minus (0.5*(HHL(k)+HHL(k+1)) - HSURF)

shared_height_init_column.rule: first canonical index (x fastest, south row first) with PS > 100000 Pa, verttransform_mod.f90:309-319

interface_pressure_candidates.definition: interior half levels 2..74; loglinear = ln P linear in height between adjacent full levels at HHL; arithmetic = FLEXPART non-ECMWF conv_mod.f90:629 form; geometric = sqrt(P_k P_k+1)

identity.full_level_layer_bounds: model-level message k has first surface (150, k) and second surface (150, k+1)
